title: An integrable weight times a test form pulled back by a Lipschitz map is integrable (supplied step 3, third item)
statement: Let Q, n ∈ ℕ, L ≥ 0 (NNReal), H : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q L-Lipschitz, S ⊆ ℝⁿ any set, g : ℝⁿ → ℝ integrable on S (Lebesgue measure), and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^Q) a test form (TestFormOn univ n: a smooth n-form with compact support). Then the function z ↦ g(z)·ω(H(z))(DH(z)e_0, …, DH(z)e_{n−1}) is integrable on S, where DH(z) := fderiv ℝ H z and e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1 ∈ ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (H : Euclid n → Euclid Q) (S : Set (Euclid n)) (g : Euclid n → ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid Q)) n), LipschitzWith L H → IntegrableOn g S → IntegrableOn (fun z => g z * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid Q) n) (H z) (fun a => fderiv ℝ H z (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) S
